body:
Maya: Quick note — I need to swap primary for tonight's window. Flight delayed, won't be online from 22:00-02:00 PT. Can someone cover primary 21:45-01:45?
Jordan: I can take primary starting 21:45 if Maya confirms runbook and handoff notes. leaving at 22:00 is tight though.
Maya: Thanks Jordan. I'll do a fast handoff at 21:30. Main things: active deploy to prod-frontend (canary) at 22:15, watch latency spikes and error-rate.
Maya: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see "canary rollback" section). Also will paste checklist below.
Maya: ```
Handoff checklist:
- Open incident channel if any 5xx > 0.5% over 5m
- Confirm canary traffic percentages: 5% -> 25% -> 100%
- KV cache warmup monitor: redis kv-miss > 10% -> alert owner
- Fallback policy: route -> model-small when latency > 800ms
```
Jordan: Got it. Do we have a secondary assigned?
Priya: I can be secondary from 21:45-02:00. Will mute but watch pager.
Alex: FYI incident-bot just paged last week for the canary flake. What exact telemetry should Jordan watch?
Maya: Primary metrics to watch: token latency p50/p95, request_errors/1m, backend 5xx. Dashboard: /dashboards/serving/canary (I'll include short links in the handoff DM).
incident-bot: [AUTO] Page sent to Jordan and Priya — oncall notification for eng-oncall (rule: primary-change).
Jordan: I saw the page. Quick question — if we see regen fallback trigger, do we immediately rollback?
Priya: agreed: if fallback triggers >3x in 10m, rollback canary and escalate.
Maya: Correct. Immediate rollback if either: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR fallback triggers 3x in 10m. Otherwise hold and join triage.
Sam: I'll be reachable for deploy rollback ops if needed (SSH access and job owner).
Alex: Can we add a short mitigation snippet for the runbook in case of model overload?
Maya: Add this to runbook quick commands: ```
# Force route to smaller model variant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"target":"gpt-small-v2","reason":"handoff emergency"}'
# Pause canary
kubectl annotate deploy frontend canary=false --namespace=prod
```
Jordan: Perfect. One more: who is the backup for Priya if they get paged with another incident?
Priya: If I'm paged elsewhere, Sam will be backup secondary. Sam acknowledged above.
Sam: I confirm. If both of you are unavailable, I will open a temporary coverage ticket and notify oncall@redwood.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll DM Jordan a short status at 21:25 with last-minute notes (active requests, open customer tickets).
Jordan: Sounds good. I'll take primary at 21:45 and post a short status message in #eng-oncall when I assume.
Priya: I'll watch pager silently and will join if something pops up.
Maya: Leaving notes: open customer ticket #C-3421 (chat latency). Not blocking canary but keep an eye.
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll call for canary hold if customer impact > low.
incident-bot: [AUTO] Handoff recorded: Maya -> Jordan (primary), Priya (secondary). Coverage window 2026-03-15T21:45:00Z to 2026-03-16T01:45:00Z.
Maya: Thanks everyone. If anything unexpected, @Jordan ping me and I'll try to join. Otherwise, have a smooth watch. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Thanks — will post start message at 21:45 and add small runbook note under "active-handoffs" section.
Priya: Good luck, Jordan.
Sam: Standing by.
Alex: Cheers, all.
